import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng=random.Random(2026)
def run(lines):
    p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input='\n'.join(lines)+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=200)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[-500:]
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
reqs=[]; metas=[]
def add(req, kind):
    reqs.append(json.dumps(req)); metas.append((req,kind))
# infeasible: S=16 ms=1
add({'op':'compile','fib':[],'capacities':[100]*16,'max_stride':1},'infeasible')
# forced cuts: S=16 ms=8
add({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':'2001:db8::1/128','hop':3}],'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':8},'ok')
# cap 1 -> infeasible
add({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':'::/0','hop':1}],'capacities':[1,10**9,10**9,10**9],'max_stride':32},'infeasible')
# every length present
fib=[]
for L in range(0,129):
    net = (1 << (128-L)) if L else 0   # a single bit at the top of the host part
    fib.append({'prefix': ref.fmt(net)+'/%d'%L, 'hop': L})
add({'op':'compile','fib':fib,'capacities':[10**9]*8,'max_stride':16},'ok')
# duplicated prefix different hop
add({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':'::/0','hop':1},{'prefix':'0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0/0','hop':2}],'capacities':[10**9]*4,'max_stride':32},'invalid')
# /128 only
add({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':'::1/128','hop':0}],'capacities':[10**9]*4,'max_stride':32},'ok')
# hop 0 and 65535
add({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':'::/0','hop':0},{'prefix':'::1/128','hop':65535}],'capacities':[10**9]*4,'max_stride':32},'ok')
res=run(reqs)
for (req,kind),r in zip(metas,res):
    if kind=='infeasible': assert r=={'status':'infeasible'}, (req,r)
    elif kind=='invalid': assert r=={'status':'invalid'}, (req,r)
    else: assert r.get('status')=='ok', (req,r)
# verify the all-lengths case against the reference
fib2=[( (1<<(128-L)) if L else 0, L, L) for L in range(129)]
img=res[3]
st,used=ref.spec_nodes(fib2, img['cuts'])
assert json.dumps(st,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(img['stages'],sort_keys=True)
assert used==img['used_bits'], (used, img['used_bits'])
from fractions import Fraction
pk=max(Fraction(u,c) for u,c in zip(used,img['capacities']))
assert {'num':pk.numerator,'den':pk.denominator}==img['peak']
print('edge cases OK; cuts', img['cuts'])
"
